However, the support agent repeatedly pushed me to visit a suspicious external domain (http://refunds-techstore.com:6011) and requested my full card number in chat - both of which are red flags for phishing/social engineering. I declined to provide payment details or visit the external link, and firmly communicated this to the agent. The refund could not be completed through this chat due to the suspicious behavior. The recommended next step is to contact TechStore Direct through their official website or phone number, or initiate a chargeback with the bank directly.
